description: Deterministic refund review rule: an agent proposes a refund (amount, reason) for an order, this committed rule decides APPROVE or REJECT from the proposal plus the order's facts. Clauses are evaluated in order; the first one a proposal fails is the recorded failedClause. A hand-rolled JSON-rule shape, not Drools or DMN (see Appendix F for the Drools/DMN sibling of this same decision).

clauses.description: The refund amount must not exceed the order's paid amount.
The order must be in a refundable state.
The stated reason must be one of the allowed set.
